title: FIRST FIRE rover design result
description: A single run of the independent rover sizing models. Physical quantities use the units specified at each field. Null denotes a missing measurement, an inapplicable model or an outcome that the calculation cannot establish.

sourceIds.description: Identifiers in sources.json for the selected component references and shared calculation or environmental references. A reference may describe an analogue or a method without measuring the selected assembly.

mobility.description: Static support and optional accelerometer comparison.

massKg.description: Declared chassis, other hardware, payload and occupants.

idealSupportAccelerationMs2.description: Modelled support acceleration on level ground, or zero in ideal orbital free fall.

staticSupportN.description: Total ideal support force associated with the declared mass.

staticLoadPerWheelN.description: Equal static load per wheel on level ground. Null for orbital free fall.

specificForceNormMs2.description: Magnitude of the user-provided accelerometer sample. Null when no reading is supplied.

stationaryNormAgrees.description: Agreement within the input tolerance. Null when a stationary, surface-supported comparison is unavailable.

power.description: Constant-power generation, requested load and bounded battery state over the scenario duration.

generationW.description: Solar electrical generation under the specified illumination.

demandWh.description: Total electrical demand over the selected period.

endWh.description: Stored energy at the end of the period.

curtailedWh.description: Energy beyond the available battery capacity.

thermal.description: Single radiator heat balance at a prescribed surface temperature.

netLongwaveOutW.description: Net infrared radiation outward. A negative value represents net absorption.

absorbedSunW.description: Radiator heat input from direct sunlight.

rejectedMinusLoadW.description: Net infrared rejection minus direct solar heating and the specified internal load.

air.description: Dry, regulated cabin gas inventory, metabolic demands and makeup gas. Null for an open deck.

metabolicCO2G.description: Carbon dioxide produced over the period.

scrubbedCO2G.description: Carbon dioxide removed from the crew-generated amount.

unremovedCO2G.description: Crew-generated carbon dioxide exceeding available removal.

outwardLeakMol.description: Outward loss to leakage. Null for an inward pressure gradient.

accessLossMol.description: Net gas vented by access cycles. Null for an inward pressure gradient.

replacementMixtureMol.description: Cabin mix to replace access and leak losses. Null for an inward pressure gradient.

oxygenSupplyG.description: Oxygen to cover metabolism plus oxygen lost with cabin gas. Null for an inward pressure gradient.

nitrogenSupplyG.description: Nitrogen to replace the nitrogen lost with cabin gas. Null for an inward pressure gradient.

coupon.description: Ideal stoichiometric coupon calculation. Null for an open cabin or an uncharacterized material.

stoichiometricO2Mol.description: Oxygen required by the complete reaction.

netChemicalPotentialKJ.description: Complete-reaction net chemical energy for the prescribed mass.

inventoryCoversDemand.description: Whether initial cabin oxygen covers the stoichiometric demand.

tracer.description: Passive impulse transported between two equal zones. Null for an open deck.

sourceMgM3.description: Source-zone concentration at the end of the observation window.

remoteMgM3.description: Other-zone concentration at the end of the observation window.

atSamplingZoneMgM3.description: Concentration at the sampling position at the end of the observation window.

tracerAccountedMg.description: Tracer mass accounted for across both zones.

thresholdTimeWithDelayS.description: Earliest ideal alarm time including sampling delay. Null when no alarm is available within the observation window.

flow.description: Mean local flow under the assumed return-duct geometry. Null for an open deck.

ductSpeedMs.description: Exchange flow divided by duct cross-section.

relativeDirection.description: Direction of duct flow relative to the assumed direction of spread away from the coupon ignition end.

spreadRateMmS.description: Unresolved flame spread. The geometric calculation supplies no measured propagation rate.

suppression.description: Agent inventory during a commanded discharge.

deliveredKg.description: Mass delivered, capped by available inventory.

remainingKg.description: Mass remaining after the commanded discharge.

extinction.description: Extinguishment is outside the inventory model.

sourcing.description: Coupon stock procurement, excluding processing qualification.

feedG.description: Required feed mass at assumed usable yield.

trimG.description: Mass difference between required feed and usable coupon.

traceability.description: User-declared batch identifier or an explicit indication that the lot is unknown.

qualification.description: The stock record supplies no flight qualification.

notes.description: Explanatory model limits and warnings for the selected case.
